title: Stonecutter Like Sawmill (SLS)
description: A vanilla-friendly datapack that lets you use the stonecutter as a sawmill.
body:
## Features
The datapack brings wood crafting in line with vanilla stone parity:
* 1 Plank yields 1 Stair.
* 1 Plank yields 1 Fence.
* 1 Plank yields 2 Slabs.

## Vanilla Backport Compatibility 
The datapack includes full support for the [Vanilla Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport) mod, i.e., players on version 1.21.1 can use Pale Oak.
